What type of PR is this?

/kind feature

What this PR does / why we need it:

  • Adds EncryptionAlgorithmType and KeyGeneratorFunc, enabling the kubelet to select a key algorithm for certificate signing requests
  • Adds clientCertificateKeyAlgorithm and serverCertificateKeyAlgorithm fields to KubeletConfiguration, defaulting to ECDSA P-256
  • Supported algorithms: ECDSA-P256, ECDSA-P384, RSA-2048, RSA-3072, RSA-4096, ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87

Which issue(s) this PR is related to:

#141838

Special notes for your reviewer:

Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

Kubelet: KubeletConfiguration now supports selecting ECDSA, RSA, or ML-DSA key algorithms for client and server certificate requests. The default remains ECDSA-P256.

Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.:

func TLSVersion(versionName string) (uint16, error) {

The check I added looks like a good fix.

This test script forces ML-DSA-65 and TLS1.2, which results in the expected error if the Kubelet is misconfigured.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
go test ./pkg/kubelet/apis/config/validation/ ./pkg/kubelet/certificate/keyalgorithm/
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
go build -o "$tmp/kubelet" ./cmd/kubelet
printf 'apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1\nkind: KubeletConfiguration\nserverCertificateKeyAlgorithm: ML-DSA-65\n' >"$tmp/cfg.yaml"
out=$("$tmp/kubelet" --config="$tmp/cfg.yaml" --tls-min-version=VersionTLS12 2>&1 || true)
grep -q 'ML-DSA requires VersionTLS13' <<<"$out" || { echo "FAIL: $out" >&2; exit 1; }
echo PASS
